==Trivia==
In the epilogue, Professor Kukui can be found wearing Kommo-o helm, Kommo-o breastplate, Kommo-o tassets, Kommo-o Greaves, and Kommo-o sollerets. Professor Burnet can be found wearing Luran headband, Luran tank, Luran shorts, and Luran shoes. Lastly, Moon can be found wearing halter top white with the long and straight sideswept bangs.
